findingDetails.title: The automatic nudge names a note path in a directory it never creates
findingDetails.evidence: plannedNotePath builds the handoff note path but never creates the handoffs directory; only /speckit:handoff does.
findingDetails.recommendation: Create the handoffs directory with mode 0700 in plannedNotePath and add a clean-state test.
findingDetails.scopeProof: All five automatic adapters route through plannedNotePath; no mkdir exists in nudge or the adapters.

findingDetails.title: A second handoff can orphan the first open note and a later nudge can reuse the stale path
findingDetails.evidence: prepare overwrites the loop record and supersedeClaimed only closes claimed notes, while openNotePathFor returns the first open note in directory order.
findingDetails.recommendation: Reuse or supersede the session's open note before a new record, and prefer the newest open note; add a two-invocation test.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The two planners disagree and no test covers two open notes for one session.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: The packet spans seven child phases, five automatic runtime adapters, and a wrapper; the correctness targets are non-trivial.

targetSelection.selectionReason: Correctness of the shared note planner and the prepare/consume path that carries the handoff between sessions.
omittedHighRiskTargets: killer lock and signal machinery; scheduled for the maintainability pass
adapter payload parity; scheduled for the traceability and broadened passes

searchLedger.hypothesis: An automatic nudge can name a note path whose parent directory has not been created.

searchActions.result: The path is joined to the handoffs directory; no creation call exists.
Only the manual command document creates the directory.

searchLedger.rationale: The automatic path names a file under a directory that a fresh checkout does not contain.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A second prepare can leave an earlier open note that a later nudge reuses out of order.

searchActions.result: The record is overwritten without reconciling an earlier open note.
The planner returns the first open note in readdir order.

searchLedger.rationale: The record and the planner can name different notes for the same session.

searchLedger.invariant: A short write is surfaced instead of reported as success.

searchActions.result: The returned byte count is compared with the expected length and a mismatch throws.

searchLedger.rationale: The prior short-write advisory is fixed in the reviewed code.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: The write and throw path is present and tested.

searchLedger.invariant: The wrapper rebuilds the same runtime seed and carries the selected model, name, and provider.

searchActions.result: The wrapper tests cover the seed form and carried values for each runtime.

searchLedger.rationale: No seed-form defect was found in this pass.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: The tested forms match the adapter expectations.
